findings.detail: read_decisions globs crew_home()/decisions/*.json and lead_decisions.decision_path resolves that same directory with the same filename, so reverting lost_session_work.raise_lost_session_work to write_json_atomically(decision_path(session), record) still yields a row whose project, session and records satisfy validate_decision.
